lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five to six horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, following a staggered geometric distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal longitudinal lines of blobs, forming a matrix of nodes where the highest intensity pixels are concentrated.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the primary central ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadowing on the ventral side, extending from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent linear orange-pigmented marking is visible on the lateral flank directly ventral to the first dorsal fin. Additional orange-tinted linear marks and potential abrasions are visible on the upper and lower lobes of the caudal fin.
